name: text-150m-cont
_about: Round 2 (docs/KAGGLE_LM_PLAN.md, C5): continue the round-1 152M model on new FineWeb-Edu documents (lm.prepare_text --continue-from) on Kaggle. Same seed and eval_windows as round 1, so validation losses are on the same 160 windows. total_tokens and micro_batch are set by the notebook's benchmark and gate (kaggle/text150m_train); wsd lets total_tokens rise between sessions until the decay starts.
